name: sseg-viewer
description: Shows a virtual 7-segment display driven by a GPIO register whenever the debugger halts.

ssegViewer.address.description: Register to read (default GPIOC_ODR on STM32F407).

ssegViewer.bitOffset.description: Bit of the register wired to segment a. Segments a,b,c,d,e,f,g,dp use the next 8 bits.

ssegViewer.activeLow.description: Set for a common-anode display, where a 0 bit lights the segment.

ssegViewer.autoOpen.description: Open the viewer automatically when a debug session starts.
